atoms.exact_source_text: Every running colony maintains an obscured ranked vulnerability profile.
atoms.normalized_claim: Every running colony maintains a hidden ranked vulnerability profile.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player sees Role coverage and qualitative warnings
atoms.normalized_claim: The player only sees Role coverage and qualitative warnings.

atoms.exact_source_text: the game maintains exact ranking, persistence, relevance masks, and Encounter weights.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game internally maintains exact ranking, persistence, relevance masks, and Encounter weights.

atoms.exact_source_text: Deficient Role Count   | Number of contextually demanded Roles with negative Margin.
atoms.normalized_claim: Deficient Role Count is defined as the number of contextually demanded Roles with negative Margin.

atoms.exact_source_text: Sets the breadth component of shortfall-Encounter pressure.
atoms.normalized_claim: Deficient Role Count sets the breadth component of shortfall-Encounter pressure.

atoms.exact_source_text: Deficit Depth          | Sum and per-Role depth of negative Margins.
atoms.normalized_claim: Deficit Depth is defined as the sum and per-Role depth of negative Margins.

atoms.exact_source_text: Sets severity weighting and how quickly pressure accumulates.
atoms.normalized_claim: Deficit Depth sets severity weighting and how quickly pressure accumulates.

atoms.exact_source_text: Persistence            | Number of consecutive Dawns a Role has remained thin or exposed.
atoms.normalized_claim: Persistence is defined as the number of consecutive Dawns a Role has remained thin or exposed.

atoms.exact_source_text: Breaks ties, supports escalation, and distinguishes a deliberate brief risk from chronic neglect.
atoms.normalized_claim: Persistence breaks ties, supports escalation, and distinguishes deliberate brief risk from chronic neglect.

atoms.exact_source_text: Big Weakness           | Worst-supported Role among those relevant to the selected Encounter family.
atoms.normalized_claim: Big Weakness is defined as the worst-supported Role among those relevant to the selected Encounter family.

atoms.exact_source_text: Defines the primary threatened value or principal manifestation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Big Weakness defines the primary threatened value or principal manifestation.

atoms.exact_source_text: Small Weakness         | Second-worst relevant Role.
atoms.normalized_claim: Small Weakness is defined as the second-worst relevant Role.

atoms.exact_source_text: Defines collateral stakes, complication, or the second thing the player cannot easily protect.
atoms.normalized_claim: Small Weakness defines collateral stakes, complication, or the second thing the player cannot easily protect.

atoms.exact_source_text: Relative vulnerability | The least buffered eligible Role even when all Margins are nonnegative.
atoms.normalized_claim: Relative vulnerability is defined as the least buffered eligible Role even when all Margins are nonnegative.

atoms.exact_source_text: Shapes unavoidable external events without increasing shortfall-generated frequency.
atoms.normalized_claim: Relative vulnerability shapes unavoidable external events without increasing shortfall-generated frequency.

atoms.exact_source_text:
DIRECTOR RULE
Total deficiency determines how often the colony is tested by shortage-driven MEET. The Big and Small Weaknesses determine what the test is about.
atoms.normalized_claim: Director rule: total deficiency determines how often the colony is tested by shortage-driven MEET, while the Big and Small Weaknesses determine what the test is about.

atoms.exact_source_text: The exact tuning remains hidden and non-canonical
atoms.normalized_claim: The exact tuning of pressure calculation remains hidden and non-canonical.

atoms.exact_source_text: the reference implementation may use: Pressure Index = Deficient Role Count + Total Deficit Depth + Persistence Modifier, subject to a cap, minimum interval, and category cooldown.
atoms.normalized_claim: A reference implementation may compute Pressure Index as Deficient Role Count + Total Deficit Depth + Persistence Modifier, subject to a cap, minimum interval, and category cooldown.

atoms.exact_source_text: The purpose of the count term is to make broad under-support matter
atoms.normalized_claim: The count term's purpose is to make broad under-support matter.

atoms.exact_source_text: the depth term makes a single severe deficiency matter
atoms.normalized_claim: The depth term makes a single severe deficiency matter.

atoms.exact_source_text: persistence makes chronic thinness different from a one-day expedition gamble.
atoms.normalized_claim: Persistence makes chronic thinness different from a one-day expedition gamble.
